name: split-halves
why: A part printed in two halves — the shape DSL_GAPS §9 said needed a flag and two evaluations. Each half is 23800 minus a 735.419 mm³ circular segment of the bore, 23064.581 mm³ by the closed form in the script, the two sum to the one-piece block less the kerf, and the clearance between them is the 0.5 mm kerf exactly. Eight faces each: five of the box, the bore's arc, and the cut plane in two strips because the bore's chord parts it. The right half is the left mirrored, so a mirror that stopped reflecting would put the two on top of each other and read as interfering.
